verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents OpenAI API compatibility, saying existing applications can switch by changing the API key, base URL and model ID, and markets this as 'just two code changes' [cerebras-docs-3, cerebras-docs-4]. It also documents OpenAI-standard shapes such as `image_url`, alongside streaming, tool calling and structured outputs. The model ID must also change, so the swap is not strictly 'only base URL and API key'. Missing for 10: confirmation that the model ID change is the only extra edit, independent hands-on corroboration of a drop-in OpenAI SDK swap, and documentation of any unsupported OpenAI parameters or endpoints.
